reasons: CS3213 is only offered in Sem 2 (even semesters). The student is in Sem 4. The earliest Sem 2 is Sem 6. CS3219 requires CS3213, so CS3219 can be earliest in Sem 7. CS3230 requires CS3219, so CS3230 can be earliest in Sem 8. However, the student must take CS3230 and CS4224 together, and CS4224 must be in Sem 7.
